hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.py) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; uv run ruff format "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; uv run ruff check --fix "$f" >&2 || exit 2; case "$f" in "$(git -C "${f%/*}" rev-parse --show-toplevel)"/groundly/*) uv run pyrefly check --summary=none --output-format min-text "$f" >&2 || exit 2 ;; esac
